name: Etihad Airways
verdict: The airline is owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi.

why.text: Etihad is owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi, part of the United Arab Emirates. In 2024, a UAE court gave 43 people, including human rights defenders, life sentences after a single mass trial that human rights monitors called unfair, and in March 2025 the UAE’s Federal Supreme Court upheld the convictions. Putting Etihad on a famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: In 2024, 43 activists in the UAE got life sentences in one mass trial, and the convictions were upheld in 2025.
